name: How long does it take to get a repipe estimate?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a repipe estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to receive a repipe estimate can vary, but generally, an in-home assessment by a plumbing professional is required to accurately gauge the project's scope. This initial assessment typically takes 1-2 hours. Following the assessment, CG Plumbing Solutions aims to provide a comprehensive estimate within 24-48 hours. Factors such as the complexity of your plumbing system and the size of your property in locations like Summerlin or North Las Vegas can influence this timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-home assessment for a repipe estimate typically takes 1-2 hours, with the estimate provided within 24-48 hours after the visit.
